text:
maria: quick sync 1 — propose splitting intake into a tiny triage-runner (fast checks) and a bench-runner (full suites). goal: onboard experimental models faster without noisy full benches.
kevin: sounds good. what are the absolute must-have triage checks?
san: fingerprint, tokenizer smoke on ~16 prompts, param count, single-forward sanity, and a tiny kv-cache alloc probe. keep the triage <20s.
julia: add an op-compat scan when loading the graph; fail fast on unsupported ops so converters don't get noisy.
arun: operational note: triage should be free/quota-light; bench-runner consumes bench credits and queue. add a "fast_path" registry flag for internal experiments.
eli: for golden compares, keep artifacts small: top-20 logits + float16 compressed embedding.
maria: thresholds: token overlap top-k > 0.8 as warning; embedding cosine > 0.95 as warning. triage warns on regressions; bench-runner enforces stricter cutoffs.
kevin: shim idea: minimal container that normalizes input dtypes/shapes and emits quantization hints. version the shim and store alongside model metadata.
bench-bot: bench-bot: created job `triage/1719999999` assigned to @eli. ETA 30m.
eli: running triage with: `./triage/run_fast.sh --model-id=$ID --prompts=16 --kv-probe` will post logs.
bench-bot: bench-bot: job triage/1719999999 completed. logs: gs://bench-artifacts/1719999999/logs.tar.gz
eli: initial result: tokenizer edgecase on prompt with emoji — classified TOKENIZER_FAIL. snippet posted to artifact.
kevin: emoji tokenization is common on older vocab tables. route TOKENIZER_FAIL to tokenization team with reproducer.
san: automated taxonomy for failures: TOKENIZER_FAIL, UNSUPPORTED_OP, OOM_PROBE, OUTPUT_MISMATCH, PERF_ISSUE. attach minimal repro and owner tag for each.
julia: UI: triage panel should show quick metrics (token overlap histogram, embed cosine), shim diff, and one-click re-run. also list historical triage runs for the model.
arun: i'll add `/v1/models/:id/triage` returning status + quick_metrics + artifacts_url. will include fast_path flag in registry.
maria: action items: 1) @arun add triage endpoint + fast_path flag. 2) @san produce 16-prompt canonical sets for families + tokenizer edgecases. 3) @eli run triage on pending models and attach logs. 4) @kevin add shim versioning to registry. 5) @julia mock triage UI. i'll draft a short RFC tonight.
kevin: thanks — aim is to reduce turn around for experiments from days to hours while catching most blockers. iterate thresholds after first 25 models. :rocket:
